title: Analytics Dashboard
objective: Present API-driven metrics with reusable charts and data tables.
scenario: Present API-driven metrics with reusable charts and data tables. Build in increments, keep a written acceptance checklist, and verify one failure or boundary case per major workflow.

milestones.title: Filterable metrics and date range
acceptance_criteria: Filterable metrics and date range works with reproducible steps and an expected result.
A relevant empty, invalid, loading, or failure state is handled where applicable.

milestones.title: Pagination and data formatting
acceptance_criteria: Pagination and data formatting works with reproducible steps and an expected result.
A relevant empty, invalid, loading, or failure state is handled where applicable.

milestones.title: API error recovery
acceptance_criteria: API error recovery works with reproducible steps and an expected result.
A relevant empty, invalid, loading, or failure state is handled where applicable.

milestones.title: Lazy-loaded pages and responsive components
acceptance_criteria: Lazy-loaded pages and responsive components works with reproducible steps and an expected result.
A relevant empty, invalid, loading, or failure state is handled where applicable.

stretch_features: Add test coverage for one additional boundary case.
Measure and document one performance or accessibility improvement.
tests_and_validation: Run the application in a local create-vue/Vite project.
Test keyboard-only interaction and responsive layouts.
Check console/network errors and the empty/failure paths.
Document the tested browser, runtime versions, and repeatable test steps.

rubric.criterion: Loading, error, empty, and boundary cases

review_method: Human review using the rubric. CodeLeaf does not execute the complete Vue project; include reproducible local test evidence.
status_note: Draft brief derived from the supplied Vue curriculum PDF; human review required before publication.
